pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base on the proposal-stipulated exact 24-pair census at n=3, equally weighted across twelve extra-retries and twelve total-attempts cells versus their fixed complete careful-English controls.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated state at the scheduled round still serves this exact revision as seconded with no token_delta measurement
all 24 proposal-stipulated pairs are present and unique
exactly twelve extra-retries and twelve total-attempts cells use n=3
the action list and both careful-English control templates exactly match the proposal's declared token prerequisite
all three registered tokenizer encodings load only after the attempt is minted
every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed once without tuning or retry
the result is labelled price-only and is never used as comprehension evidence

manifest.comparison_note: This deterministic prerequisite measures only the price of the registered count-basis markers against the proposal-pinned complete controls. It does not measure comprehension, retry safety, idempotency, adoption, or execution correctness.
manifest.item_selection_rule: The proposal itself stipulates this exact 24-pair census: twelve named byte-stable actions crossed with both forms at n=3 and the exact fixed careful-English control for each form. The packet was frozen before attempt mint and before any tokenizer encoding was loaded.
manifest.method: After minting the exact stored manifest, load each registered tokenizer and count each complete UTF-8 sentence using ordinary encoding with no special tokens. Per-pair delta is tokens(ainglish) minus tokens(english). Report all counts, each marker-stratum mean, and each tokenizer mean. The filed scalar is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. The result is price-only and cannot establish comprehension.
